verificationMethod: traced config/config.js, server/auth/auth.controller.js, server/auth/auth.route.js: single symmetric string secret (config.jwtSecret) used for both sign and verify, default HS256
notes: Tool crashed on Zod schema validation (missing citedEvidence[0].note) before reaching a verdict — an agent-reliability failure, not a judgment error. verificationMethod: read config/express.js's morgan(log) call and morgan/index.js source directly (line 63 fallback logic, line 164 'default' format definition)
notes: Confirmed via a subtler mechanism than the tool found: outside development, log = {stream:{...}} has no .format property, so morgan falls back to fmt = opts.format || 'default', and the 'default' format string does include :remote-user. Dev mode uses 'dev' format instead, which is safe. Tool's citation was generic and never traced this app-specific fallback.
